answer: Per-identity stake + slashing: every identity must lock a 100-token deposit into a multi-entry stake array (mesa) and register via a single escrow inlet before it can vote/grade. A farm of 1000 clones pays 1000×100=100,000 tokens; if audit detects any stake that wanders across array rows to share one payout address, the whole deposit is slashed. honesty stays cheaper.
